nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=22 beats='first snow on Maple Hill; Priya age eight and Arun age four stop at the top after one last run; Arun lifts a foot wearing only a soaked sock; the red boot with the peeling yellow star sticker is gone'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=46 beats='the crossing whistle blows at four and Grandma Nita waits in the blue car at the lot; Priya counts three places worth trying, the sled lane dropping away below them, the warming hut breathing cocoa steam, and a line of dog prints crossing the fresh snow'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=66 beats='Priya tows the red saucer sled down the packed lane while Arun rides; braided sled tracks cross everywhere and she turns up a striped mitten and a juice lid but no boot; below her the lane bottoms out at the gray plow ridge standing taller than she is, and off to the side the frozen hay bales sit stacked like hard benches with Wren and the long toboggan beside them'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=24 beats='Priya chips at the crusted plow ridge with the edge of the red saucer sled; a boot toe appears, but it is black and far too big for Arun; beside it the snow gives way soft under her knee'>>

choices.label: Dig where the snow is soft

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=24 beats='behind the frozen hay bales the wind whistles through a dark gap; Wren tips one bale up with the nose of the long toboggan while straw and old sled wax spill across the snow'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=44 beats='the crust cracks open into a hollow that smells like cold stone and something red shows far back in the dark; the hollow is deeper than the whole arm of Priya and her fingers sting through wet mittens; down at the gate the plow truck idles with its amber light turning slow'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=44 beats='under the tipped bale a small red shape sits jammed in the straw with only the heel showing; Wren says the bales get stacked three deep and that lost things work their way down to the bottom; Arun hops to keep his cold foot off the snow'>>

<<FILL role=transition words=24 beats='the red boot comes free at last, packed hard with snow and heavier than it looks; Priya carries it to the fence post by the gate while Arun hops beside her on one warm foot'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=66 beats='Wren tips the next bale and a small red boot rolls out with the peeling yellow star still stuck to the heel; it is packed solid with old straw and ice and will not go on a foot like that; the four whistle starts up across Maple Hill and Arun is shivering hard now; the fence post stands close by the gate and the warming hut is close too'>>

choices.label: Empty it at the fence post
Carry it to the warm hut

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=24 beats='they run the ice packed boot into the warming hut where the stove pipe ticks; Mrs. Delgado holds it over the warm air until the ice inside slides loose'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=66 beats='the warming hut breathes cocoa steam and wet wool; Mrs. Delgado works the plywood counter with a clipboard and a stub of pencil; a crate of lost things sits under the long bench; Arun holds his sock foot near the stove pipe while Mrs. Delgado offers either to hush the whole hut and call out for the boot, or to let them dig the crate themselves'>>

choices.label: Ask her to call the hut
Dig the lost and found crate

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=24 beats='Mrs. Delgado cups her hands and calls for a small red boot with a peeling yellow star on the heel; two different answers come back from the crowded benches'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=24 beats='the crate holds odd gloves, one ski, a purple boot, and a scarf gone crunchy with ice; Priya digs to the bottom with both arms while Arun holds the lid up'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=44 beats='one kid saw a red boot hung by its laces on the mitten tree post; another saw the plow driver lift something red at the gate and carry it into his truck; outside the light goes flat and blue and Arun walks slower and slower'>>

choices.label: Run to the mitten tree post
Catch the driver at the gate

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=44 beats='under the icy scarf sits a red boot with the heel worn smooth and no star on it at all; Mrs. Delgado says a second red one went out to the mitten tree post this very morning'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=24 beats='the mitten tree post wears a crown of frozen mittens and one small red boot hangs from it by knotted laces with the yellow star turned out toward the hill'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=66 beats='Arun pushes his sock foot into the starless boot and it flops loose at the heel, two sizes too big, but it is dry inside and it is warm; the four whistle rolls across Maple Hill and Grandma Nita flashes the lights of the blue car twice; Priya can borrow this one for the walk home or make one more run out to the mitten tree post'>>

choices.label: Borrow it for the walk home

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=24 beats='Mrs. Delgado writes the name of Arun on the borrow line of her clipboard and knots the loose laces twice around his ankle so the big boot will stay on'>>

choices.label: Clomp out to the blue car

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=66 beats='paw prints stitch a neat line away from the sled run toward the crossing while Mr. Okafor whistles for Biscuit and holds his orange sign up over the road; the prints are fresh and they are heading somewhere on purpose; Mr. Okafor watches this whole hill every afternoon and may have seen a red boot go by; Arun shivers in his one boot and the light goes blue'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=66 beats='at a split stump the paw prints divide, one line dropping away toward the frozen creek and the culvert pipe, the other circling back up toward the sledding hill; Arun tucks his sock foot behind his knee like a heron and asks how many minutes are left; down at the creek the dry reeds are rattling and something is moving inside them'>>

choices.label: Take the prints to the creek

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=24 beats='Mr. Okafor lowers his orange sign and says Biscuit carried something red past the crossing twice today, both times heading down toward the culvert pipe'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=66 beats='the frozen creek ticks under its skin of ice and the culvert pipe breathes gray air; dry reeds rattle where a tail is swinging back and forth; Biscuit bursts out of the reeds with something soggy and red in his teeth and starts a game of keep away along the bank; Priya has exactly one granola bar left in her pocket and Arun laughs out loud for the first time all afternoon'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=44 beats='the culvert pipe holds a drift of brown leaves, one flattened ball, and a curl of red rubber pinched under a lip of ice; Biscuit noses in beside Priya, whines, and scrapes at the ice with one paw'>>

choices.label: Chip the ice off the rubber

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=24 beats='Biscuit drops the soggy boot straight into the mitten of Priya and licks her wrist; creek water runs out of the heel in a thin brown line'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=66 beats='the chase runs all the way down to the creek bend where Biscuit finally drops the boot in the reeds and Priya lands flat on her elbows in the snow; the boot is stuffed with gravel and cold creek water and the yellow star has curled up at one corner; the four whistle starts across Maple Hill and Mr. Okafor is still up at the crossing with his sign'>>

choices.label: Run it up to Mr. Okafor

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=24 beats='Mr. Okafor holds the boot upside down over the road grate and thumps the heel until gravel, creek water, and one very surprised beetle drop out'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=66 beats='the plow driver leans out under his turning amber light, promises to check the ridge before he pushes it, and writes the number of Grandma Nita on the back of his glove; there is no boot tonight; Arun walks to the blue car with a bread bag pulled over his wet sock while the four whistle rolls across Maple Hill; Priya promises him they will be back at nine in the morning'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=44 beats='Priya knocks the boot twice against the fence post and a packed lump of snow shaped like a foot slides out; the yellow star is stuck fast; Arun shoves his foot in, stamps it down twice, and they beat the whistle to the blue car'>>

ending.title: Stamped On at the Fence Post

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=44 beats='the boot comes off the stove pipe warm and dry and smelling like hot rubber; Arun pulls it on and announces that his toes are toast; Mrs. Delgado crosses a line off her clipboard and holds the hut door open for them'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=66 beats='the plow driver swings his door open and lifts the red boot off the warm heater vent where he set it that morning after finding it at the gate; it is dry and toasty all the way to the toe and the yellow star has gone soft with heat; Arun shoves his foot in and shouts once, loud; Grandma Nita honks the blue car horn twice from the lot'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=44 beats='a stranger hung the red boot on the mitten tree post for whoever came back for it, star turned out so it could be seen from the hill; Arun pulls it on over his wet sock and Priya ties a double knot'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=44 beats='the borrowed boot clomps like a horse and Arun makes it clomp harder on purpose; his own red boot stays lost somewhere on Maple Hill, and Mrs. Delgado promises to hold it behind the counter if it turns up tomorrow'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=66 beats='the circling paw prints end at a snow fort where three older kids have built a whole wall out of lost boots, and not one of them carries a yellow star; the four whistle rolls across Maple Hill and Grandma Nita flashes the lights of the blue car; Priya scratches their phone number into the fort wall with a stick, and Arun walks to the car with a bread bag pulled over his wet sock'>>

ending.title: The Fort Wall of Lost Boots

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=44 beats='Priya tips the boot upside down and creek water, gravel, and half a leaf slide onto the snow; the star sticker has curled at one corner but it is stuck fast; Arun hugs the wet boot up the bank and stamps it on at the gate'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=44 beats='Mr. Okafor smooths the yellow star flat with his thumb and hands the boot back dry side up; Arun names the beetle Snowy and lets it go under a rock; then the orange sign goes up and they cross to the blue car'>>
